lines.text: Ziz does acrobatics in the air with Emma on her back.
The Liberalio bodies spurt water at them, and they narrowly dodge out of the way.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: You're good at this. You must be used to flying.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Oh, uh, yeah. I... have to be good at something.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Oh, move to the right.
Ziz barrel rolls to avoid an attack. She turns to look behind her.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Don't worry about me. I won't fall off.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Y-you're really hanging on back there...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hehe. I just have so many places to grab onto.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Oh, uh... huh? Wh-what do you mean?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I was talking about these mechanical parts of yours.
As they keep dodging, Ziz feels anxious.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: W-wouldn't it be better for me to transform?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: I can't increase my speed or altitude in this form.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: No, if you transform, it'll be easier for them to hit you.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Do you think you could've dodged those attacks earlier if you'd transformed?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: No, but it doesn't matter if I get hit in that form.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Sure it does. It hurts you, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: That's... true...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: You have to save your strength when you can. There's no need to waste anything.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: If the enemy tries to use force against us, we can just dodge out of the way.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: That's how people fight.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: How... people fight...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: You're actually already faster than you need to be.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Can you make your wings any smaller? It still feels like you're a bigger target than you need to be.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Oh, um, yeah. I can. It'll slow me down a bit, though...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Then just make them smaller a little bit at a time, until you think you've got the best balance between speed and wing size.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: O-okay.
They continue flying around, dodging the attacks of the Liberalio bodies.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: B-but do we really just need to fly around trying not to get hit?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: It doesn't feel like... we're helping all that much...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Of course. We're doing plenty.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: And wh-what exactly are we doing? Just drawing their attention?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: No. Did you notice they're not attacking nearly as much as they were before?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Oh... Now that you mention it...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I've been spraying highly concentrated Alva Particles at them this whole time.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: It's so concentrated that we almost never use it in battle.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: The moment I spray it, I could actually die.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Eek...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: But it's safe for me to spray it while flying around, since we immediately maneuver away.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Still... everyone else is fighting so hard. I feel like I should be doing more...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Ziz... I mean, Beast 3.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: This ability of yours is incredible. The ability to fly freely in a fight is an unbelievable advantage.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: There's so much you can do with it. So there's no need to put yourself on the front lines and become exhausted.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: You can help everyone by flying around, then joining in at decisive moments.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: It's safe to say you're the main muscle, the heavy artillery of the Four Beasts.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Don't push yourself. And trust your allies.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Okay?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Y-yeah... okay.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Great. Then let's be careful and keep spraying away.
*Pshoo! Pshoo! Pshoo!*
Vesti launches multiple missiles.
They fly toward the Liberalio bodies but are all intercepted.
Beside her, Leviathan shoots Dark Matter at high speeds.
Her attacks also get blocked by streams of water.
Vesti and Leviathan avoid the bodies' attacks while putting some distance between them.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Their defenses against frontal attacks are more or less perfect.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: All our attacks get intercepted before they can even hit.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Y-you can teleport or something, right?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Oh, you mean make Dark Matter tunnels?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Yeah. I want to use them to make sneak attacks.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Just to let you know, I can't create those in the air or places like this.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It has to be connected to the ground.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: What about from over there?
Vesti points to the tip of a rocky mountain.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... Yeah, but... you're going to jump from there?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Yeah. I'm going to jump down and rush at them.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I think it will be more effective if I fire missiles from point-blank range.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Forget it. They're shooting down your missiles already. You think you'll be any different?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Make me a shield.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Shield me until I get right on top of them.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: While you're falling? You think that's possible?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'd have to match the timing of your jump and create a shield in front of you.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You're basically asking me to move Dark Matter along your same trajectory and at your same speed.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Calling that difficult doesn't even begin to express it.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I'd like to be able to see, too, so please make an opening for my eyes.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You're not listening to a word I say.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: What, you can't do it?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: No, I can't. There's no way to pull off what you're asking for.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Okay, I guess that means the only thing you can do is transform.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: When we fought before, I thought you were really good at controlling Dark Matter...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: But maybe it only felt that way to me because I was so much weaker at the time.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: All right. You can just wait here. If I think you're in danger, I'll shout so you can get out of the way.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Hey.
There's a slosh as a pile of Dark Matter appears on the ground.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I connected it to the tip of that mountain. Go inside and don't breathe. You'll get taken there in about ten seconds.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: And the shield?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... I'll try.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: That isn't good enough... I'm putting my life on the line...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Fine! I'll do it! I'll make it work!

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Are you sure you can actually do it?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Who do you think you're talking to?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: When it comes to controlling Dark Matter, I'm the best there is.
Vesti nods before throwing her body into the black pit.
Leviathan moves her gaze to the peak of the mountain.
She stares at it intently. Shortly after, she sees Vesti jump.
Leviathan focuses on her.
*Bang!*
Eunhwa lands a rifle shot on one of the Liberalio bodies.
Only a moment passes before Behemoth whips her claws in that same spot.
With a crack, a fragment of the body goes flying.
*Bang!*
Eunhwa's shots continue hitting their marks.
*Crack!*
Almost instantly after, Behemoth throws her claws.
Eunhwa's shots act as a guide, directing Behemoth's attacks.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... Incredible.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I'm not even sure you can call what she's doing a follow-up to my shots. She's striking almost simultaneously.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: How do you develop reflexes like that?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: And every time, she hits with enough force to tear through the thing's armor.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... Heh, she really is a monster.
Eunhwa adjusts her camouflage scarf.
She returns to her position and continues firing.
*Bang! Bang! Bang! Bang!*
*Crack! Crack! Crack! Crack!*
The shots of the rifle and the crack of the armor ring out in the same rhythm.
Eunhwa can't stop herself from smiling.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... This is fun.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I'm actually having fun.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Now I get why people play games.
*Bang!*
Sparks fly as she fires.
Behemoth swings her claws. The Liberalio body lists to the side as fragments go flying.
*Bang!*
They do it again.
Behemoth suddenly has a thought.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: ... Huh. I haven't been hit once.
She launches her claws at the place where Eunhwa's shot directs her to.
It's simple.
Yet, it's enough to change the direction of the tentacles flying at her,
making the Liberalio body lose its balance.
She continues to strip away the armor from near its core.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: She seems to be analyzing its movements and figuring out precisely where to strike.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: She also keeps changing her location as she fires.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: ... She's a monster.
*Bang!*
*Crack!*
A shot strikes a tentacle headed for Behemoth, and she swings her claw.
The water shooting from the tentacle hits only air.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: ... This is fun.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Haha. I'm really having fun.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: It feels like playing a game.
With a clang, Behemoth's claw strikes the armor near the Liberalio body's core.
This time she manages to tear it off, revealing the core.
Just then, a black sphere falls from above.
There's a small hole in the sphere, with blue eyes just visible through it.
*Pshoo! Pshoo! Pshoo!*
Spouts of water burst from the body's tentacles.
Behemoth's claws strike one tentacle away, but the other attacks the black sphere.
The water blasts strike the black sphere, but they can't knock it away.
The sphere disappears, revealing Vesti.
She lands on the core and activates her weapon.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Got you.
*Booooom!*
An explosion bursts out.
The Liberalio body slowly falls.
Behemoth steps on the falling body and pushes off of it.
She grabs Vesti in her arms and lands on the ground.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: ... You shot us with those things before.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: And you used those claws against us too, so we'll call it even.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Haha. Deal.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Target down. One remaining.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... We took that down without a single injury on our side?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Th-that's amazing...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I figured we'd be a good match... but we're an even better team than I expected.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Hm? What'd you say?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hehe. It's a secret.
*Rumble!*
The ground shakes.
The Four Beasts feel a familiar rumbling and instinctively look to the distance.
A wave that seems impossibly tall rushes toward them.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... Ugh. Not this again.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Beast 1, respond with a wave of Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I can't. The only way I could do it before was because I amassed a large amount of Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Beast 3, transform.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Put us all on your back and fly up as high as you can.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: O-okay.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: E-Emma, was it? The flash might hurt your eyes, so... be careful.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Oh, how sweet of you.
Black light bursts from Ziz's body.
The transformed Ziz spreads her black wings.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: G-get on, quick!
*Rumble!*
The wave bears down on them.
Everyone gets on the transformed Ziz's back, and she shoots up into the air.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Hang on, Bahamut's not here!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Beast 4 has an assignment. She must stay on the ground.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Wh-what...?!
Ziz soars up into the air.
She flies so high that the Liberalio body looks small.
Eunhwa watches the wave approaching from far away.
She shifts her gaze to Bahamut, who's looking up at them.
*Bang!*
Eunwa's rifle spouts fire.
It hits Bahamut's head with precision.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Huh.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: What did you do that for?!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: That's the signal.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: What was that? Something hit my head, but it was only a flash of a sensation.
Bahamut suddenly remembers Eunhwa's words.
She raises her hands, and a black pillar shoots up.
It strikes the back of the Liberalio body that's shooting water at Ziz.
*Crack!*
However, the pillar fails to pierce through.
The end only goes in slightly.
The Liberalio body responds by swinging its tentacles toward Bahamut.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: Am I, the astute Beast 4, to be used as bait?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Emma, do the math.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Okay. Let's see...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: One-and-a-half meters to the front at eleven o'clock.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Beast 1 and 2.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Jump a meter and a half to our eleven o'clock.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: ... Huh?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Quick. There's no time. The wave will catch up to Beast 4 soon.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Wh-what's going on?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Care to explain yourself? You think just because you're helping us that you can...

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: What is it?
Leviathan looks at Eunhwa.
Eunhwa nods her head, signaling to them to jump quickly.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... Hah, you're insane.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: It'll work, though, won't it?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Let's go, Behemoth!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Aha! So there's a plan!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Okay! Let's go!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Huh? What...?
Leviathan and Behemoth jump off of Ziz.
They look at the Liberalio body below as they fall from high above.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Behemoth! Transform!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: ...! Oh, I get it!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Haha! Right! This only works because it's us!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It pisses me off, but yeah!
Black light bursts from Leviathan's and Behemoth's bodies.
An enormous bull and a large crocodile suddenly appear in the air.
They fall,
trusting their bodies to gravity.
The Liberalio body shoots water at the falling bull and crocodile,
but they don't stop. Gravity has the two beasts firmly in its grasp.
*Booooom!*
Leviathan and Behemoth land on the body,
pushing it down with their enormous weight.
The Liberalio body falls.
*Crunch!*
It's pierced by Bahamut's black pillar.
It struggles but can't manage to free itself.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Haha. Who wants jellyfish kebab?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I've never seen you have this much fun, Eunhwa.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Y-yeah, you're really enjoying yourself.
Bahamut watches the scene before her in stunned silence.
The Liberalio body is pierced by a black pillar with a bull and crocodile pressing it down.
Bahamut pushes up her lenseless glasses,
and then sends her black pillar through the core of the wriggling body.
The final Liberalio body falls silent.
The sweeping wave loses its strength and collapses.
*Shaaaaa*
It becomes a shallow, ankle-high wave that soaks the ground.
Absolute and the Four Beasts look at the crumbling Liberalio body.
Eunhwa steps forward, her feet splashing.
She silently thrusts her fist out.
Emma and Vesti hold their fists out too.
Behemoth grins and holds out her fist.
With a smile, Ziz does the same.
Leviathan awkwardly adds her fist,
and Bahamut holds out her flat palm proudly, as if to say that she wins.
*Bump*
They all tap fists.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Monsters.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Haha. Look who's talking.
